summary.result: The results of analysis of correlation between the satisfaction of farm experience village visitors and the improvement of package design of farm specialty products showed that the important factors of package design are easiness of transport handling, easiness of storage, and functionality of packaging materials.
summary.background: It was found that the satisfaction with package design when purchasing farm specialty products affected the satisfaction of farm experience village visitors.
summary.method: In case of farm experience village visitors, they were more satisfied with the purchase when they were satisfied with the package design of farm specialty products they purchased.
